baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated form-II verbs at words 2 and 4 switch from a present active accusation against the addressee to a past passive description of earlier messengers.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root branch concerns assigning falsehood to a person or claim. The grammatical switch removes the present addressee from an isolated confrontation and places the accusation inside a recurrent social act whose past agents need not even be named.

activation_trace.role: The attribution branch makes both verbs acts of publicly classifying a bearer or claim as false, rather than bare private nonbelief.

changed_reading.before: They reject the message as untrue.
changed_reading.after: They assign falsehood to its bearer, but the active-to-passive historical echo recasts that public classification as a recurring role rather than a uniquely personal defeat.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 5, 10, and 11 place messengers, return, and affairs in one closing movement.
baseline_models.mechanism: A messenger is both carrier and carried communication, while the return root can describe a reply or speech coming back. The final clause can therefore be heard as a referral circuit: a carried word meets a hostile reply, but the disputed case and its answer return to the originating authority.

activation_trace.role: The messenger-and-message branch supplies a carrier whose defining function is to bear communication outward.
The returned-answer branch turns return into the coming back of speech, making the closing clause an adjudicative reply circuit.
The affairs-and-cases branch identifies what is referred back for disposition.

changed_reading.before: All matters ultimately go back to God.
changed_reading.after: The accusation is a hostile answer to a carried word, yet the whole disputed case is routed back for the only final answer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The indefinite plural at word 5, the temporal phrase at word 7, and the return verb at word 10 form a sequence rather than a single comparison.
baseline_models.mechanism: The messenger root can picture successive cohorts, the precedence root supplies earlier position, and return closes each outward movement. Rejection is one station in a repeated dispatch-rejection-return history.

activation_trace.role: The succession branch supplies one dispatched group after another and converts the plural into serial historical movement.
The precedence branch orders the present encounter after earlier ones without making them identical.
The basic return branch closes the outward sequence by restoring every episode to its point of accountability.

changed_reading.before: Earlier messengers provide a generic precedent for consolation.
changed_reading.after: The addressee occupies one position in a serial dispatch whose repeated rejection never interrupts the larger outbound-and-returning movement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The accusation in words 2 and 4 is followed by the exclusive destination of the affairs in words 9 through 11.
baseline_models.mechanism: The deniers can issue a social verdict by assigning falsehood, but the authority branch latent in the affairs root and the explicit return clause deny them final jurisdiction over that verdict.

activation_trace.role: The attribution branch supplies the human verdict imposed on messenger and message.
The authority branch activates jurisdiction inside the returned affairs and distinguishes social labeling from governing power.
The restoration branch removes the case from the accusers' custody and returns it to its final authority.

changed_reading.before: The verse consoles the messenger that God will handle events later.
changed_reading.after: The audience may pronounce falsehood, but its verdict has no final jurisdiction because authority over the case returns elsewhere.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening, holding, and sending contrasts of 35:2 form a control system around the messenger root. In that system, rejection can obstruct human reception but cannot revoke a dispatch whose release is not controlled by the rejecters.

activation_trace.role: The opening branch supplies an unblocked channel and begins the control contrast.
The holding-and-confining branch names the opposite operation and locates restraint inside the paired clauses.
The release-and-dispatch branch makes sending the explicit counterpart to holding.
The same dispatch branch anchors the control system back in the focus messengers.

structural_cues: 35:2 balances opening against holding and holding against sending in mirrored clauses.
Messenger language is placed inside governed channels in 35:1-2 before 35:4 addresses rejection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the open-hold-send control axis; I infer that denial is an attempted social restraint whose arrow stops at reception, not at the dispatch itself. A live alternative is that 35:2 asserts sovereignty without characterizing denial as restraint.

changed_reading.before: Rejection threatens to nullify the messenger's mission.
changed_reading.after: Rejection can close hearers around themselves, but it cannot cancel the prior act of release that made the messenger a messenger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning against glittering deception in 35:5 and the adorn-see sequence in 35:8 expose a production line for false judgment: a bad act is cosmetically improved, then perceived as good. The focus accusation is thus not only spoken denial but the output of a trained appearance system.

activation_trace.role: The basic falsehood branch anchors the context's perceptual mechanism in the focus accusation.
The deceptive-glitter branch supplies an attractive surface that fails to remain true.
The beautifying branch supplies the operation that manufactures the misleading surface.
The badness branch preserves the underlying negative value beneath the improved appearance.
The seeing branch supplies the uptake step by which cosmetic falsehood becomes a settled judgment.

structural_cues: 35:5 warns twice against deception, while 35:8 orders adornment before seeing and seeing before grief.
The object judged good in 35:8 remains the same bad work that was first adorned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive shine, beautification, badness, and seeing; I infer a causal arrow from altered appearance to the accusation in 35:4. The live alternative is that this sequence diagnoses the rejecters' self-reading but not the production of their accusation against the messenger.

changed_reading.before: They verbally contradict a true message.
changed_reading.after: Their accusation can be the social output of a perceptual loop in which bad action is beautified, seen as good, and then used to classify the messenger as false.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 35:8 the addressee's own self is at risk of going away in accumulated regret over the rejecters. Read back into 35:4, the return of affairs establishes an ownership boundary: the messenger carries the word, but does not carry the conversion outcome inside himself.

activation_trace.role: The carrier branch defines the messenger's task as bearing the communication rather than owning its reception.
The restoration branch relocates the outcome away from the messenger's interior burden.
The affairs branch identifies the outcomes whose custody is returned.
The going-away branch supplies the threatened motion of the addressee's self under grief.
The self-as-very-entity branch marks what must not be consumed by the audience's response.
The regret-over-loss branch supplies the affective pressure that wrongly transfers outcome ownership to the messenger.

structural_cues: The prohibition in 35:8 makes the addressee's self the grammatical subject of departure and the rejecters the occasion of grief.
The focus closes by moving all affairs toward God rather than leaving them with either disputing party.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the messenger's carried word, the self's threatened departure, grief, and returned affairs; I infer that the closing return clause reallocates responsibility for results. The alternative is simple consolation without a precise boundary between delivery and conversion.

changed_reading.before: The historical comparison merely tells the messenger not to feel uniquely rejected.
changed_reading.after: The comparison and return clause prevent him from internalizing reception as his possession: delivery is his role, while the result exits his custody.

context_deltas.mechanism: The meteorological chain in 35:9 sends wind, stirs cloud, drives it to dead land, and restores life. Together with the rain-and-return branch latent in the focus return verb, it opens a circulatory reading: dispatch may remain causally alive after immediate rejection and reappear as renewal elsewhere or later.

activation_trace.role: The dispatch branch anchors the meteorological sending sequence back in messenger movement.
The returning-water branch makes circulation, repetition, and renewed effect latent inside the focus return.
The same dispatch branch explicitly releases the wind and supplies the first stage of the material analogy.
The moving-air branch gives the dispatch a carrier that is effective without being grasped.
The rising-and-spreading branch supplies latent activation after the initial release.
The driving branch adds directed transfer through an intermediate carrier.
The earth-reviving branch supplies delayed visible efficacy at the far end of the chain.

structural_cues: 35:9 presents an ordered relay from sending through stirring and driving to revival, then identifies the sequence with rising again.
The focus places messenger dispatch immediately before universal return, allowing an outward-and-back geometry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the meteorological relay and a return branch associated with recurring water; I supply the analogy from that material chain to the afterlife of a rejected message. The live alternative is that 35:9 activates resurrection only and says nothing about delayed messenger efficacy.

changed_reading.before: Return is a terminal endpoint after a failed encounter.
changed_reading.after: Return can also be a phase in a life-bearing circulation: what is dispatched may pass through hidden stages and produce renewal after the scene of rejection looks dead.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus stages a horizontal accusation against a carrier. In 35:10 good speech ascends, fitting action raises it, and hostile scheming perishes; in 35:31 revealed writing is truth that confirms what precedes it. Return therefore acquires a vertical and evidentiary geometry in which rival claims receive different trajectories.

activation_trace.role: The attribution branch supplies the contested human classification whose verdict is tested by later trajectories.
The carried-word branch identifies what is exposed to accusation and subsequent validation.
The returned-speech branch makes adjudication of utterance a live sense of the closing movement.
The upward-motion branch gives worthy speech a trajectory beyond horizontal public judgment.
The intelligible-speech branch identifies the verbal object whose ascent counters the falsehood charge.
The raising branch supplies action as the lift that makes verbal truth consequential.
The ruin branch gives hostile fabrication the opposite trajectory from ascending speech.
The reality-matching branch supplies the standard against which the accusation is reversed.
The fulfillment-and-verification branch makes later revelation an active confirmer of prior communication.

structural_cues: 35:10 assigns ascent, raising, and ruin within one contrastive sentence.
35:31 describes revealed writing as both true and confirming what stands before it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite trajectories for good speech and hostile scheming plus later confirmation; I infer that these trajectories adjudicate the focus accusation. The alternative is that ascent and confirmation concern speech and scripture generally, without promising public vindication of the messenger.

changed_reading.before: The focus says only that God will decide a disputed matter.
changed_reading.after: The disputed word already enters an asymmetrical process: truthful speech rises and is confirmed across transmissions, while the machinery set against it moves toward ruin.

context_deltas.mechanism: The call-hear-answer sequence in 35:14 fails for alternate powers, while the verse closes with unsurpassed knowledge of the case. That failure sharpens the focus return into a forum for disputed communication: the final respondent is the one capable of hearing, answering, and knowing the affair's interior.

activation_trace.role: The messenger-and-message branch supplies the communication brought before the answering forum.
The reply branch makes return specifically capable of carrying an answer back through speech.
The authority branch frames the destination as a competent jurisdiction rather than an inert endpoint.
The calling branch initiates the communication test posed to rival addressees.
The understanding-and-compliance branch makes true hearing more than acoustic receipt.
The verbal-response branch supplies the answer the alternate addressees cannot give.
The knowledge-of-inner-reality branch supplies competence to report the case as it truly is.

structural_cues: 35:14 tests a complete communication chain: call, hearing, response, and authoritative report.
The focus's passive return leaves the returned affairs available for such an answering function.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a failed communication test for rival powers and a knowing reporter; I infer that the focus destination functions as the only competent answering forum. A live alternative is that 35:14 concerns worship alone and does not specify how the focus accusation is answered.

changed_reading.before: Affairs return as impersonal objects for settlement.
changed_reading.after: The accusation and message return as a communicative case to the only addressee able to hear fully, answer, and disclose its interior truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning is distributed across communities in 35:24, but 35:18 insists that burdens cannot be transferred between bearers. The analogy with earlier messengers therefore transmits orientation without transferring guilt, merit, or outcome wholesale from one generation to another.

activation_trace.role: The precedence branch supplies the earlier cases from which analogy is drawn.
The succession branch carries warning through multiple cohorts without collapsing them into one bearer.
The heavy-burden branch gives each moral load weight while the syntax denies its transfer.
The borne-liability branch distinguishes carrying one's charge from making another carry it.
The warning branch supplies the recurrent function shared across otherwise distinct histories.
The community branch distributes that function among separate collectives rather than one undifferentiated audience.

structural_cues: 35:18 repeats bearing language while explicitly blocking substitution between bearers.
35:24 universalizes warning by repeating it across communities, not by declaring every response identical.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent warning and nontransferable burden; I infer a constraint on how the focus historical analogy works. The alternative is that burden nontransfer applies only to final judgment and does not qualify the rhetoric of historical comparison.

changed_reading.before: Because earlier messengers were denied, the present audience simply repeats the same collective script.
changed_reading.after: The function recurs, but responsibility does not migrate between generations: precedent consoles and warns without predetermining or merging distinct bearers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near echo in 35:25 expands the compressed focus precedent: accusation repeats, but the earlier messengers arrive with disclosed signs, written records, and illuminating communication. The seizure and repudiation in 35:26 then supply the reversal left implicit in the focus return clause.

activation_trace.role: The restoration branch leaves room for the reversal that the later sequence makes explicit.
The authority branch identifies the jurisdiction that can reverse the accusers' verdict.
The repeated attribution branch reproduces the focus charge and marks the later passage as an unpacking of the same event type.
The precedence branch repeats the focus's temporal placement and binds the two passages.
The carried-message branch restores content and evidence to the otherwise indefinite earlier messengers.
The disclosure-by-sign branch supplies evidence that makes denial answerable rather than merely contrary.
The writing-and-record branch gives the carried evidence durable historical form.
The ordered-written-expression branch adds a second durable medium to the evidentiary chain.
The illumination branch makes the written communication disclose rather than merely preserve.
The taking-to-account branch supplies the procedural consequence after rejected evidence.
The repudiation-of-the-reprehensible branch reverses the direction of denial onto the deniers' own conduct.

structural_cues: 35:25 repeats the focus conditional, accusation root, earlier-time phrase, and messenger plural in almost the same order.
35:26 follows that expanded evidence list with first-person taking and a question about the resulting repudiation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a near-verbatim echo followed by evidence and consequence; I infer that 35:25-26 expands the compressed procedure in 35:4. The alternative is that the later passage restates the theme independently rather than narrating what return in the focus entails.

changed_reading.before: The earlier messengers are only a consoling memory of similar mistreatment.
changed_reading.after: They instantiate a recurrent procedure: falsehood is assigned, evidence remains and illuminates, then authority reverses the accusation by taking the rejecters to account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inherited book in 35:32 produces differentiated recipients: one wrongs himself, one keeps a middle course, and one moves ahead in good. That spectrum prevents the conditional plural in 35:4 from becoming a total theory of every audience member or every later reception.

activation_trace.role: The attribution branch identifies one possible reception act without requiring it to exhaust the social field.
The successive-carriers branch lets communication continue into later communities where responses can differentiate.
The inherited-knowledge branch supplies transmission beyond the original messenger encounter.
The median branch supplies a reception position between wrongful refusal and leading response.
The precedence branch supplies an active leading response rather than mere absence of denial.
The beneficial-good branch gives the leading response a positive direction.

structural_cues: 35:32 repeats a three-part distribution among recipients of one inherited book.
The focus begins conditionally, so its plural need not assert that every hearer performs the denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transmission of a book and three response positions; I infer that these positions qualify the social scope of the focus conditional. The alternative is that 35:32 classifies believers only and should not be projected back onto the earlier denial scene.

changed_reading.before: The messenger faces a binary collective: they deny, while he is denied.
changed_reading.after: Denial is one live branch of reception inside a longer transmission that can also yield compromised, measured, and leading responses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The plea in 35:37 asks for exit and another chance to act differently, but the prior warning and present tasted state block that reversal. This constrains the circulatory reading of return: recurrence can operate in history and nature, yet final return includes a threshold after which the loop does not reopen.

activation_trace.role: The turning-back-from-an-act branch supplies the possibility whose availability the later plea tests and limits.
The affairs branch carries the entire lived case, including missed opportunities, into the final return.
The outward-exit branch states the requested reversal of the present state.
The intentional-action branch names the unrealized alternative the speakers want to perform on a second pass.
The remembering branch shows that an earlier interval for recognition had already been supplied.
The warning branch identifies the prior messenger intervention that makes the refused second chance accountable.
The transition-into-a-state branch marks consequence as now inhabited rather than merely announced.

structural_cues: 35:37 quotes a counterfactual request for return to action and answers it by recalling sufficient lifetime and warning.
The imperative to experience the consequence closes rather than renews the requested cycle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies requested exit, unrealized better action, prior warning, and present consequence; I infer an irreversible threshold that weakens an unlimited circulation model. The alternative is that the threshold belongs only to punishment and does not limit other senses of return in 35:4.

changed_reading.before: The circulation activated by 35:9 could make every return sound like another opening in a repeating cycle.
changed_reading.after: Historical and ecological recurrence coexist with a final edge: once the affair returns for consequence, the missed messenger encounter is not simply replayed.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 35:42 an emphatic oath claims that a warning messenger would produce superior guidance; when the warning actually arrives, it increases aversion. The focus denial can therefore be read as defensive recoil generated by encounter, not as a neutral conclusion reached for lack of a messenger or evidence.

activation_trace.role: The attribution branch supplies the overt accusation produced after the promised encounter occurs.
The apportioned-oath branch gives formal force to the audience's advance claim about its future response.
The exertion-under-pressure branch intensifies the declared commitment and makes the later reversal diagnostic.
The swearing branch identifies the speech act by which receptivity is publicly guaranteed in advance.
The warning branch supplies both the imagined and actual messenger encounter around which the response reverses.
The gentle-guidance branch names the promised effect that the actual encounter fails to produce.
The drawing-away branch supplies the actual recoil and converts denial from static opinion into defensive motion.

structural_cues: 35:42 places the hypothetical arrival and actual arrival of a warner around opposite predicted and realized responses.
The realized response is an increase in distance, not a mere absence of guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a strong prior oath, actual warning, and increased withdrawal; I infer that encounter itself triggers defensive recoil expressed as falsehood attribution. The alternative is ordinary hypocrisy between promise and conduct without a causal claim about the messenger's presence.

changed_reading.before: They deny because the message has not furnished enough reason to accept it.
changed_reading.after: The arrival of the warning can expose and intensify an already defended posture, so the falsehood charge functions as recoil from the encounter it claimed to desire.

context_deltas.mechanism: 35:40 describes peers promising one another nothing but deception, and 35:43 says harmful plotting descends around its own people inside an unreplaceable, unturnable historical way. The focus return is thereby activated not only as remote referral but as local rebound: the apparatus that manufactures denial curves back onto its makers.

activation_trace.role: The attribution branch supplies the public product generated by the peer-deception apparatus.
The restoration branch provides the focus anchor for consequence bending back toward origin.
The hope-opening promise branch supplies persuasive speech exchanged inside the rejecting group.
The part-to-part branch makes deception a distributed peer relation rather than an isolated private error.
The unstable-glitter branch identifies what those mutual promises actually deliver.
The descending-and-encircling-harm branch supplies the return path from harmful design to consequence.
The belonging-group branch identifies the scheme's own people as the enclosure in which its harm lands.
The running-way branch generalizes rebound into a recurrent historical path.
The replacement branch is explicitly negated, blocking substitution of a different consequence structure.
The transformation branch is explicitly negated, blocking diversion of the path away from its outcome.

structural_cues: 35:40 repeats part-to-part language around a promise whose only content is deception.
35:43 repeats the harmful-plot construction and makes its own people the exclusive site of encirclement.
The relevant harmful-plot root lacks a usable deceit branch in the packet, so its repeated syntax is retained only as structural support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mutual deceptive promising, encirclement of the scheme's own people, and an invariant historical path; I infer a causal arc from denial-producing coordination to returned consequence. The live alternative is narrower: rebound applies specifically to plotted harm and not to every act of denying a messenger.

changed_reading.before: All affairs are eventually transported away to a remote judgment.
changed_reading.after: Return can begin inside the denying system itself: peer-made deception produces a harmful design whose consequence closes around the group that authored it.

context_deltas.mechanism: 35:44 turns earlier peoples into a traversable field of visible aftermath, including groups stronger than the current audience who still could not escape. 35:45 then supplies postponement to a fixed term. The focus precedent is therefore inspectable rather than proverbial, and return is delayed rather than absent.

activation_trace.role: The precedence branch supplies the earlier field that later becomes open to inspection.
The restoration branch supplies the eventual outcome whose apparent delay needs explanation.
The moving-through-land branch turns historical comparison into embodied investigation.
The directed-perception branch supplies deliberate reading of historical evidence.
The final-outcome branch identifies what the traveler is asked to inspect.
The repeated precedence branch directly reactivates the focus's earlier-messenger comparison.
The gathered-strength branch supplies a stronger comparison class and removes weakness as the cause of their outcome.
The escape-from-pursuit branch is negated and blocks the inference that greater force can outrun return.
The postponement branch explains why consequence need not coincide with the moment of denial.
The fixed-term branch gives delayed return a bounded schedule rather than indefinite absence.

structural_cues: 35:44 commands movement and looking before asking about the outcome of those before them.
35:45 contrasts immediate taking with explicit postponement and then repeats the appointed term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inspectable aftermath, failed escape by stronger peoples, and a fixed postponement; I infer that these features explain how the focus return remains operative during apparent delay. The alternative is that historical inspection proves power only, while the scheduling clause addresses a separate mercy theme.

changed_reading.before: The appeal to earlier messengers is a conventional saying, and return may seem absent when rejection has no immediate consequence.
changed_reading.after: The precedent leaves visible traces that can be investigated, while the lack of immediate reversal is scheduled delay rather than evidence that return has failed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus root's branch for a colored garment whose displayed condition misleads. It remains anchored by the two focus verbs and is sharpened by adornment, seeing, and changed color in the context. Downstream prose should render it only as a material analogy for deceptive presentation, never as a translation of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Both accusation verbs at words 2 and 4 share a branch inventory that includes misleading display by a colored surface.

activation_trace.role: The misleading-garment branch supplies a material surface whose visible state makes a false claim about what it is.
The beautifying branch provides the operation that dresses an underlying condition for display.
The visual-perception branch provides the observer who accepts the dressed surface as the thing itself.
The taking-on-new-color branch extends the analogy from adornment to altered visible classification.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a false sentence spoken about the messenger.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, denial behaves like a dressed surface: presentation changes what observers think they see, and the resulting visible classification lies about the underlying message.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates an animal-motion idiom under the focus accusation root. It remains anchored by messenger dispatch and return, then gains kinetic support from aversion, travel, and historical trace. Downstream prose should present it as an as-if image of interruption and recoil, not as the lexical meaning of denial.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moves from accusation through dispatched messengers to return, allowing the root's halt-and-look-back branch to animate that movement without replacing its ordinary sense.

activation_trace.role: The run-then-halt branch supplies a kinetic image of forward motion interrupted by a backward look.
The dispatch branch supplies the forward movement that denial attempts to interrupt.
The return branch distinguishes eventual restoration from a frightened or arrested backward glance.
The recoil-and-distance branch gives the later audience the backward kinetic response imagined by the outlier.
The travel branch reopens forward movement as the proper way to investigate what denial tries to arrest.
The rear-foot-and-trace branch supplies the material remainder visible when one looks back along a path.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a stationary verdict that stops the messenger's progress.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, denial is a break in stride and recoil, while dispatch continues and return converts the backward look into inspectable trace rather than mission failure.

strongest_changes: The open-hold-send contrast of 35:2 makes denial an attempted restraint that cannot cancel dispatch.
The deception and adorn-see sequences of 35:5 and 35:8 shift falsehood from speech alone into manufactured appearance and trained perception.
35:9-10 supports two coexisting geometries of return: life-bearing circulation and vertical adjudication of speech.
35:25-26 expands the focus into an evidence-rejection-reversal procedure rather than a bare consoling precedent.
35:42-45 makes denial defensive recoil within an invariant but delayed pattern whose effects return to their authors.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's active-to-passive accusation, messenger polysemy, and several return branches remained live at once. Context did not disambiguate them into one reading; it activated a control system, an affective responsibility boundary, a speech-answer circuit, a material circulation, a social rebound, and a final irreversible edge.
remaining_uncertainties: The returned-answer branch may be only an analogy under the passive return of affairs, not a direct sense in this construction.
The meteorological relay may activate resurrection without supporting delayed efficacy of a rejected message.
The three reception positions in 35:32 may classify an already believing group rather than qualify the denial scene.
The colored-surface and halted-run outliers should remain explicitly figurative even if downstream prose preserves them.
